definitions.explanation: a person of lower rank, status, or age; often used in workplace or social hierarchy contexts

examples.japanese: {目下|めした}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{接|せっ}する→接する：12920_sessuru⟧。
{目下|めした}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{尊敬|そんけい}される→尊敬する：22429_sonkeisuru⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become a boss who is respected by my subordinates.
He treats both his juniors and seniors the same way.

notes:
HIERARCHY VOCABULARY:
{目下|めした} refers to someone of lower status, the opposite of ⟦{目上|めうえ}→目上：03804_meue⟧ (superior).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目上|めうえ}→目上：03804_meue⟧ - superior, elder, someone of higher status
- {目下|めした} - subordinate, junior, someone of lower status

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{部下|ぶか}→部下：06453_buka⟧ - subordinate (workplace)
- ⟦{後輩|こうはい}→後輩：02501_kouhai⟧ - junior (school/work)
- ⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧ - senior (school/work)
- ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧ - boss, supervisor

WATCH OUT:
Note that there is a homograph {目下|もっか} meaning "at present; currently" which has a different reading.

KEIGO CONTEXT:
Japanese language uses different speech levels depending on whether one is speaking to ⟦{目上|めうえ}→目上：03804_meue⟧ or {目下|めした}.
